name: Fortune Information Systems Corp
summary: Fortune Information Systems Corp (FISC) is a well-established Taiwanese firm specializing in comprehensive information system integration and a broad range of professional IT services. Their expertise spans enterprise cloud solutions, covering both public and private infrastructure planning, deployment, and ongoing monitoring. They also deliver robust network system design, critical information security measures, and strategic backup and redundancy planning. Furthermore, FISC is adept at custom software and project development. In addition to these core offerings, the company provides specialized integration services for financial institutions and comprehensive document management, including microfilm production and digital imaging. Their portfolio extends to logistics and warehouse management systems, as well as tailored software and informational support for the insurance industry. Other services encompass professional video and imaging technology integration, IT equipment provision, and comprehensive maintenance management. Founded in 1966, Fortune Information Systems Corp is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
